scope_limits: Only the specified exact-real four-block, no-LN graph, one coefficient and fixed stationary positive fast-mixing order-two binary source are covered. No general architecture, minimax, learned-parameter or ordinary IEEE conclusion follows.

The score-relative coefficient eta_N=c/(N+2) and absolute scalar-weight change 4c/(N+2) differ. These are N-dependent perturbed models, not one fixed deployment. The previous fixed-q 3/16 limit has different quantifiers.

Critical c=2 uses the genuine moving-target correction: only the L1 difference tends to zero. Neither the moving terminal comparator nor terminal window is asserted to converge; no independent query is introduced.

Fixed-c open intervals require both endpoint companions and reviews for the combined positive-c statement. Varying c_N and c>3/2 remain outside that group, apart from the separately proved c=2 example.
The c=1/2 all-N claim compares final model outputs, not entire residual vectors or an exact common 1/2 output at N=2. The c=3/2 terminal data-index formula requires N>=3.
